section_blueprint.title: You click. A billion things happen.
section_blueprint.description: Cinematic hero featuring kinetic title reveal, Three.js particle field, interactive wireframe processor, mouse parallax, and 'ENTER THE MACHINE' CTA with camera zoom transition.

section_blueprint.title: 01 / THE FIRST CLICK
section_blueprint.description: Micro-switch actuation: Voltage drops from 3.3V to 0V, sending an electrical interrupt request (IRQ) down the copper traces in sub-nanoseconds.

section_blueprint.title: 02 / INSIDE THE MACHINE
section_blueprint.description: Interactive hardware architecture map showcasing CPU, RAM, GPU, SSD, PSU, Cooling & Network with glowing hover pins and expandable modal fact panels.
key_interactions: Click to inspect component spec panel
Data packet flow visualization along PCIe lanes

section_blueprint.title: 03 / CPU CORE ENGINE
section_blueprint.description: The Silicon Brain: Cores, Threads, L1/L2/L3 Cache latency races, and the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) processing clock pulse cycles.
key_interactions: Cache hit vs cache miss latency race visualizer

section_blueprint.title: 04 / RAM DYNAMIC MEMORY
section_blueprint.description: Volatile Memory Grid: Transistors and capacitors holding binary charges at 6400 MT/s. Allocate and free app memory cells in real time.
key_interactions: App Memory Allocator (Chrome, Cyberpunk 2077, VS Code, Photoshop)

section_blueprint.title: 05 / SSD NAND FLASH
section_blueprint.description: Persistent Quantum Tunneling: Floating gate transistors storing data blocks. Breakdown of Storage vs Memory differences.
key_interactions: Memory vs Storage interactive comparison matrix

section_blueprint.title: 06 / GPU RENDER MATRIX
section_blueprint.description: From Math to Photons: Millions of parallel cores translating 3D geometry matrix transforms into shader pixels on screen.
key_interactions: Wireframe to Pixel shader interactive toggle

section_blueprint.title: 07 / GLOBAL NETWORK & INTERNET
section_blueprint.description: Beyond the Case: Fiber-optic cables, DNS lookup, TCP/IP 3-way handshake, and HTTP GET request traveling across continental undersea cables in 40ms.
key_interactions: Packet inspector tool with custom headers

section_blueprint.title: 08 / WHAT IF? SCENARIO LAB
section_blueprint.description: Stress-test the system: What happens when RAM fills up? CPU thermal throttles at 100°C? SSD degrades? Internet drops packets?
key_interactions: RAM Bottleneck Swap File Lag toggle

section_blueprint.title: 09 / THE DISPLAY OUTPUT
section_blueprint.description: And all of that happened because you clicked. 0.000000001 seconds after your finger pressed down, a single pixel changed color.
key_interactions: Macro Lens Sub-Pixel RGB Array inspection

section_blueprint.title: 10 / ONE CLICK. BILLIONS OF OPERATIONS.
section_blueprint.description: Epic conclusion with Re-enter Experience CTA, Konami easter egg guide, and Creator Portfolio link.

easter_eggs.konami_code: Press ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A to unlock Cyberpunk Dev HUD with live FPS, memory usage & packet stream
easter_eggs.multi_click_cpu: Rapidly click the CPU core 10 times to trigger Overclock Mode with flame particles
easter_eggs.hidden_terminal: Toggle Terminal with `Ctrl + ~` or HUD button to run commands like `help`, `cpu-info`, `ping-matrix`, `overclock`
easter_eggs.funny_packets: Data packets labeled with easter egg messages like 'HTTP 418 I'm a teapot', 'Cat GIF Packet #42069', 'User Click Interrupt'

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or sharp chamfered geometry with glowing border hover effect, backdrop blur, mono label, and active scale transition
component_guidelines.cards: Dark obsidian glassmorphism with subtle 1px border, high-contrast typography, and cyan/amber glow accents on hover
component_guidelines.hud_elements: Monospace high-density data readouts, status badges with glowing pulse indicators, and crisp technical lines
component_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, inputs, sliders, cards, modals, and toggles MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Unbounded', 'Chivo', 'DM Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' into index.html.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling engine for buttery momentum scroll storytelling.
Build lightweight Three.js background canvas particle field and wireframe 3D CPU die in hero.
Create rich interactive Canvas simulations for RAM allocation, GPU pixel shader, and network packet routes.
Include a Web Audio API synthesized sci-fi sound engine with a prominent top-right Mute/Unmute audio toggle.
Add Konami code listener and Terminal overlay easter eggs.
Provide a creative footer link pointing to https://portofolio-m.vercel.app/.
Add data-testid to every interactive button, slider, tab, modal, and card.
